$comment: A name-only record collection (SC-035, the founder's ruling of 23/11/2026): a client is a name and nothing else, which a case study may point at (clientRecord). A site enables clients on its own, independently of the other name-only collection, and it is off by default, so an existing site changes nothing. A record has no page, no route and no public address: an association is not a link, and nothing in the markup draws one. No record is created, matched by name or deleted automatically, from free text or when the switch changes.
